$comment: Static declaration of which tool namespace is AUTHORITATIVE for each service.
This file says what SHOULD be true. docs/TOOL_AUTHORITY_MATRIX.md is generated
by comparing it against configuration on disk and against recorded behavioral
The five columns are NOT synonyms and must never be collapsed:
CONNECTED   the server answered at all
EXPOSED     its real tools are present in the session, not just authenticate
ALLOWED     permission rules permit calling it
EXERCISED   someone actually called it and it worked
ET-4 lost two days because 'CONFIGURED' was read as 'that is all there is'.
#1671 is that story. Do not infer any column from any other.
